newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman LNG to sign further gas project contracts.
newsitem.headline: Oman LNG to sign further gas project contracts.

text.p: Oman LNG Co will sign on Thursday a $1.2 billion engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract with Japan's Chiyoda and Foster Wheeler Corp to build a liquefaction plant in Oman, Omani officials said on Monday.

Chiyoda and Foster Wheeler were selected in May to carry out the contract to build a liquefaction plant at al-Ghalilah which will be capable of producing an annual 6.6 million tonnes of liquefied natural gas (LNG).

A final underwriting letter and preliminary commitment letters will be signed with foreign banks financing the $2.25 billion downstream scheme on Sunday, a statement from Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals said.

The seven banks arranging the loans are ABN-Ambro, National Westminister Bank Plc, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Citibanks, Banque Indosuez INDO.BR, Korea Exchange Bank and Gulf International Bank GIOB.BH.
